verdict.rationale: GitHub documents git-native portability (clone/download-zip/fork) and REST/GraphQL APIs that let users pull out repository and account data in open formats, which supports leaving the platform with code intact (github-docs-50, github-docs-41, github-docs-40, github-docs-33). However there is no evidence of a comprehensive 'export all my data' feature (issues, PR history, wiki, settings) beyond code, and community commentary shows some users have actually left GitHub citing lock-in concerns without contradicting the export mechanics themselves (github-comm-1, github-comm-7). Missing for 10: dedicated full-account data export/GDPR-style export documentation, evidence of exporting non-code artifacts (issues/projects/discussions) in open formats, and independent confirmation that a full migration-out process works smoothly.
